differences: The paper reports 19 of 24 participants female, a mean age of 20.5 +/- 2.3 years and 87.5% right-footed; the deposit has no age, sex or footedness, so these columns are empty.

The deposit's score1 and score2 columns (one pair of numbers per participant and block, undocumented; they look like the block feedback shown by the task) and the E-Prime timing columns were not released.

The deposit's centre-of-mass summaries (MVN_AllSubsV0.2.csv, two participants, one row per sequence) and the Xsens recordings are not released; this file holds the E-Prime step data of all 24 participants only.

The deposit's Block column is the trial number within the session (1-52, with the 4 no-go trials missing), not the paper's block; it is trial_in_block here, and block is the authors' Session (1-8, the eight training blocks).

RT is the E-Prime response time of each step; for the first step it starts at the Go signal and for later steps after the previous step (the deposit does not say; the paper reports step-level response times).

excluded_by_authors marks all six steps of a sequence execution with any wrong step: the authors' linear mixed models use accurate sequence executions only (Methods.rmd; Figs 5-6 of the preprint). The R markdown has a second model that keeps wrong steps.

The title of the OSF project is 'Multimodal mobile brain and body imaging for the quantification of dance motor sequence learning'; the listed paper is the methods preprint (PsyArXiv, 2022, doi 10.31234/osf.io/ypt7n, CC BY 4.0 per Crossref). The OSF project states no license.
